spans.s: दुःश्लिष्ट a word, or words whose case affixes can be syntactically con- nected only with some difficulty; cf.बहुव्रीहौ सक्थ्यक्ष्णोः स्वाङ्गात् षच्। स्वाङ्गवाची यः सक्थिशब्दः अक्षिशब्दश्च तदन्ताद् बहुव्रीहेः षच् भवति । सूत्रे तु दुःश्लिष्टविभक्तीनि पदानि Kas, on P.

दुःस्पृष्ट produced by an incomplete contact of the करण; the term is applied to the phonetic element ळ् which is due to the incomplete contact of the organ at the pro- duction of the letter ल्; cf दु:स्पृष्ट- श्चेति विज्ञेयः; Pan, Siksa 5.
